title: Excellent sights and staff and new bus
text: Excellent english, could hear her speak, able to answer all questions, caring and careful with our safety, playful and Luz driver is very good also!  Fabulous first experience alone in foreign country!  Deborah
author: H5258YXdeborahs

title: Highly recommended
text: This was an awesome experience with Xavi!  We loved how he explained all the history.  Sagrada La Familia is stunning!  Make sure to wear comfortable shoes.  This would be a challenging walking tour for those who are not active.  Would recommend!
author: Zelisa_G

title: Thoughtfully guided experience.  Great insights into this beautiful city!
text: Xavier was wonderful! The tour moved at a great pace and he was very thoughtful about the locations and information that he provided.  He gave us breaks throughout and was super knowledgeable about everything!
author: mchiu00

title: Great tour  Great price
text: great tour with experienced guide.  tickets to events wer extra.  Couldnt get in to Sagrad Familia as tickets were gone but did get into Guell Park which was also sold out but guide got the tickets in advance
author: Chet_W

title: Absolutely AMAZING
text: Xavier was one of the best guides we have had anywhere in the world. Passionate extremely knowledgeable and a by the end of the tour he felt like family. The two day tour was well organised and efficient, but was not rushed. There was always enough time for any questions and the answers were detailed and comprehensive. Lunch on the second day was a highlight with Xavi ordering and showing us the way tapas should be eaten! Great wine choice as well! We feel that we leave Barcelona with a well balanced knowledge and feel for the great city that it is. Thank you Xavi! 10/10!!!!
author: andrewwD1372MM

title: Great intro to Barcelona
text: I did this tour 5 years ago with my husband and learned so much from our tour guide.  I returned to Barcelona and chose to repeat the tour with my son.  Both tours were excellent although there was a little variation.  Our tour guide, Montse, was outstanding.  She accompanied us (with another couple) the entire day with a smile on her face.  This was a very thorough introduction to Barcelona and it's main sites.
author: Katherine_M

title: Hilights of Barcelona
text: If you want to fit it all in this is your trip! Miguel is the absolute best! He is informative, fun and engaging! My husband and I enjoyed our time with him
author: HeatherR2462

title: Perfect tour for a limited time in Barcelona!
text: Faidra was a wonderful guide.  She guided us through all the highlights of Barcelona but provided a very personal and intimate view of the city.  An overall exceptional experience!
author: Toni_L

title: A Must for Visitors to Barcelona
text: We can't say enough wonderful things about this tour and our guide, Phaedra! It hit all of the places on our list of must-sees and provided a wealth of information about the history and architecture of this beautiful city. ❤️
author: rickmoore

title: Wonderful Day in Barcelona!
text: Miguel was so kind and gave us so much great information!  He also took great pictures for us and his knowledge  of the best spots was invaluable! We so enjoyed our day!
author: JEFFREY T N
